chirality_rotation_vs_boost.interpretation: L=(M) and R=(M^dag)^{-1} COINCIDE under rotations (M unitary) and DIFFER under boosts (M Hermitian, (M^dag)^{-1}=M^{-1}!=M). The boost is the chirality-distinguisher.

double_cover_SO31.interpretation: x -> M X M^dag induces Lambda(M) in SO(3,1) (eta preserved, det +1). Lambda(M)=Lambda(-M) -> 2-to-1; the 2pi-rotation sign flip M=-I lives ONLY upstairs (Lambda=I downstairs).

gamma5_weyl_connection.interpretation: S(M)=diag(M,(M^dag)^{-1}); gamma5=diag(-I,+I) commutes with S(M), splitting Dirac into the two Weyl reps. Restricted to rotations both blocks are the SAME SU(2) (Euclidean Spin(3)); boosts split them.

killcontrol_a_rotation_vs_boost.verdict: KILL A FIRED (chirality invisible to rotations, visible to boosts)

killcontrol_b_wrong_rep.interpretation: (M^dag)^{-1} is the epsilon-conjugate rep eps conj(M) eps^{-1}, consistent with the invariant symplectic form M^T eps M = eps. M^dag and M^T do NOT match the link (fail over boosts).
killcontrol_b_wrong_rep.verdict: KILL B FIRED (genuine (M^dag)^{-1} matches epsilon link; M^dag and M^T fail)

object: Spin(1,3) ~ SL(2,C): left/right Weyl reps + SO(3,1) double cover

sl2c_det.anchor: det exp(X) = exp(tr X); all sl(2,C) generators are traceless -> det M = 1

structural_inequivalence.interpretation: Joint nullspace of S M = (M^dag)^{-1} S over a generating set is {0} (no invertible intertwiner) -> (1/2,0) and (0,1/2) are inequivalent irreps. Control L-vs-L has nullity>=1 (S=I works), so the test is not vacuous.

summary.forced_standard_rep_theory: SL(2,C)=Spin(1,3) double cover; (1/2,0)/(0,1/2) reps; eta preservation; epsilon-invariance
summary.headline: Spin(1,3) ~ SL(2,C): the two fundamental reps L=(M), R=(M^dag)^{-1} are MEASURABLY inequivalent (only S=0 intertwines them); they COINCIDE under rotations (M unitary) and DIFFER under boosts (the boost is the chirality- distinguisher); x->M X M^dag is a 2-to-1 cover onto SO(3,1) preserving eta; and gamma5=diag(-I,+I) splits the Dirac rep into exactly these two Weyl blocks.
